# THEA at the Table

> THEA at the Table (formerly Theasty, est. 2017) is the food, travel and lifestyle site of Thea VanHerwaarden, a MasterChef Canada finalist (Top 2), recipe developer and Canadian food and lifestyle television expert. Taglines: "Good food, brighter days." and "Everyday food, lived beautifully." Home cooking that is seasonal, approachable and elevated, plus restaurant reviews and press.

Key facts:
- Author: Thea VanHerwaarden, MasterChef Canada Top 2 finalist; her n'duja ricotta tortellini was featured on the menu at Jamie Oliver's Jamie's Italian.
- Content: original tested recipes (pasta, braises, brunch, baking, drinks), restaurant and travel reviews, and press features.
- Every recipe page includes structured ingredients, step-by-step method and schema.org Recipe markup.
- Contact for partnerships and media: hello@theasty.com
